components.scope: component row, engine only: full plans and conservative research reservations persist through the existing owner before the effect starts, composed through the real coordinator and the real owners. The coordinator publishes the plan and has its budget opened at start; the trusted port reserves each request before it begins the effect; when an admitted run observes a cancellation the coordinator has the port cancel the task budget before sealing the outcome and accepts only a cancelled budget for the published plan and scope. Composed cases: interruption after a reservation and after a start, recovered on reopening with the same revision, head, counts and original clocks and without replay; rolled-back and late clocks retained as the budget's end; failed, timed-out and uncertain workers keep their spent visit; cancellation before, between and during requests; expiry between issuance and start; one budget per task and one owner per store. The native result is synthetic and the payload store is in memory; no host, worker, provider, model or network takes part, and the native dispatch stays with AMR-03.1.2 and AMR-03.2.3

mutation_checks: run on the exact source tree before it was committed, with private tooling that applies one exact replacement, runs the engine's filtered library tests (research_admission_tests) and restores the file; the specification and results are attached to the batch25-source stage. One run of 15 single mutations, 14 caught: the budget owner's context match and the issuance owner's usability check (review F1); the coordinator's budget cancellation call, the unconfirmed code, the cancelled, plan and scope checks of the owner's answer, a port failure taken as confirmed, cancelling without an observed cancellation and the kept plan reference; the owner's durable cancellation, its retained restriction on a refused reservation and its persisted reservation; and the synthetic worker's outcome. The one survivor is the N2 reorder, equivalent by design (the non-spending check writes nothing, so the refusal is the same call mismatch either way). The tree was verified identical afterwards, and no test store directory was left behind
